idea-plugin.name: QuietTab
idea-plugin.description:
QuietTab is a Copilot-style inline autocomplete that stays quiet when it isn't sure.

  • Gray-text suggestions from a local model (Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B via llama.cpp); press Tab to accept.
  • A calibrated confidence gate hides suggestions that are probably wrong.
  • Rule filters skip bad moments (mid-word, inside comments, code right after the cursor).
  • Output cleanup: syntax-aware truncation, no duplicated closing brackets, no copied lines.
  • Never sends secret files (.env, keys, credentials) to the model.

Needs the QuietTab model server running locally. See the README for setup.
